timeline.evidenceText: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.
and with them their brothers of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.
for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
Of the sons of Nebo: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.

Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

definitions.short: Mattithjah , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H4993. Mattithyah or Mattithyahu מַתִּתְיָה מַתִּתְיָ֫הוּ, proper name, masculine (compare Gray Prop. N. 294, No. 81 ); — ᵐ5 Ματταθιας , etc; — 1 a Levitical musician , מַתִּתְיָ֫הוּ 1Chr 15:18 , 21 ; 25:3 , 21 = מַתִּתְיָה 16:5 . 2 מַתִּתְיָה , Levitical name 1Chr 9:31 . 3 ׳מ , attendant of Ezra (also Levite ?) Neh 8:4 . 4 one of those who took strange wives Ezra 10:43 .
definitions.rootNote: or מַתִּתְיָהוּ ; from 4991 and 3050 ; gift of Jah ;
